title: Bilanz zur Versammlungslage mit Bezug zum Nahostkonflikt vom 7. Oktober 2026

extraction.summaryEn: Police summarized the Berlin demonstrations on the third anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel; eight pro-Israeli and two pro-Palestinian assemblies were policed. A pro-Palestinian march was dissolved early after antisemitic chants, assaults on officers and other offences; 46 criminal proceedings were opened and four officers were injured.
